title: Silence and Glasshouse
author: Ivo Oyelaran
blurb: August Joubert, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
